Hi Dana / Alex -

Appreciate the quick reply. I work with our compliance and product teams on the exact PHI handling and retention controls. High-level responses below:

1) BAA: Redwood supports BAAs for customers processing PHI. We have a standard BAA template and are happy to iterate. The attached Draft_BAA_Redwood_v1.docx reflects our typical terms.

2) SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II for the serving platform; I can share the SOC 2 report under an NDA / secure portal. We will provide the SOC 2 report and our security pack once we have a short evidence-sharing agreement in place.

3) PHI retention / logs: For Hosted deployments we retain request/response logs by default for X days for debugging and anomaly detection; however, per-customer retention settings can be configured and token-level logging can be disabled for BAA customers or set to zero retention. We also offer Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments where customer data and logs stay in your VPC and Redwood does not have access.

4) Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Hosted with BAA (and with retention controls set per contract) or Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem) for full isolation. We typically recommend Private for regulated workloads requiring strict access controls.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll upload the SOC 2 report to our secure share and send a link once NDA/portal access is arranged.
- David (cc) will own coordinating the technical deep-dive on logging and KV cache behavior for PHI-sensitive workloads - he can present options on the upcoming call.
- Marissa will follow up with procurement cadence and a proposed pilot statement of work.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Pack_Outline.pdf

-Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
